elements.description:
An assistant docked beside a page: a conversation about what's on it, with history, starters, a reflection gate for
high-stakes answers and the full chat composer. Resizable, collapses to a rail, a sheet on narrow screens.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The pane's title, its landmark's and dialog's name

properties.name: messages
properties.description: The conversation, oldest first. The app owns it

properties.name: reflectionSkippable
properties.description: Lets people skip the reflection gate

properties.name: starters
properties.description: Suggestions before the first message – derive them from what's on the page

properties.name: startersTitle
properties.description: The heading over the suggestions – unset reads "From <page>" or "Suggestions"

properties.name: conversations
properties.description: Past conversations for the History panel – unset hides History

properties.name: conversation
properties.description: The open conversation's id

properties.name: pageContext
properties.description: What's on the page – the composer's page-context chip; unset shows no chip

properties.name: disclaimer
properties.default: "AI can make mistakes. Check important info."
properties.description: The line under the composer; "" hides it

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: The composer's placeholder

properties.name: models
properties.description: The models in the toolbar's menu – the composer's defaults when unset

properties.name: model
properties.description: The picked model's id – the first model when empty

properties.name: settings
properties.description: The model settings in the toolbar's settings popover

properties.name: settingsModel
properties.description: Which settings the model supports – the settings button shows only with it

properties.name: prompts
properties.description: Templates for the toolbar's prompt library – the prompts button shows only with them

properties.name: selectProject
properties.description: Shows "Select a project" in the composer's menu (it fires tc-select-project)

properties.name: onConnectApps
properties.description: Shows "Connect apps"; may return a promise the composer waits for

properties.name: onRequestApproval
properties.description: Shows "Request approval"; may return a promise the composer waits for

properties.name: onDictate
properties.description: Dictation – see the chat composer

properties.name: demo
properties.description: The composer's demo mode: dictation and approval are simulated

properties.name: onSend
properties.type: ((message: string, details: { model: string; pageContext?: ChatPageContext }) => void | Promise<unknown>) | undefined
properties.description: Called with each sent message; return a promise to keep the text in the composer until it settles

properties.name: onRegenerate
properties.description: Called by Regenerate and Try again; return a promise to show the regenerating state until it settles

properties.name: open
properties.description: Open

properties.name: collapsed
properties.description: Collapsed to the rail

properties.name: width
properties.description: The docked width in px

properties.name: defaultWidth
properties.description: The width Enter and a double-click on the edge go back to, in px

properties.name: minWidth
properties.description: The narrowest the pane can be dragged, in px

properties.name: maxWidth
properties.description: The widest the pane can be dragged, in px

properties.name: shortcut
properties.description: Opens the pane (or moves focus into it; pressed inside, closes it). "mod" is ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere; "" turns it off

properties.name: breakpoint
properties.description: Below this width of the element, in px, the pane is an overlay sheet instead of docked

properties.name: side
properties.description: Which side it docks on

properties.name: launcher
properties.description: A floating "Ask AI" button while the pane is closed – false if your page has its own

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-send
events.description: A message was sent – append it and the answer to `messages` ({ message, model, pageContext }: SidePaneSend); `onSend` may return a promise to keep the text in the composer until it settles

events.name: tc-stop
events.description: Stop was pressed while an answer was streaming ({ id }: SidePaneMessageRef)

events.name: tc-regenerate
events.description: Regenerate, or Try again after an error ({ id }: SidePaneMessageRef); `onRegenerate` may return a promise

events.name: tc-feedback
events.description: A thumb up or down on an answer, or cleared ({ id, value, reason }: SidePaneFeedback)

events.name: tc-verify
events.description: A claim was sent to verification ({ id, claim, sources }: SidePaneVerify)

events.name: tc-reflect
events.description: The reflection gate on a high-stakes answer was submitted, or skipped with `submission: null` ({ id, submission }: SidePaneReflect); cancelable – prevented, the gate stays open

events.name: tc-new-chat
events.description: New chat was pressed – start an empty conversation; detail: null

events.name: tc-conversation-change
events.description: A conversation was picked in History – load its messages ({ conversation }: SidePaneConversationChange); cancelable – prevented, `conversation` stays (History still closes)

events.name: tc-conversations-change
events.description: History's list changed: a rename, pin, move or delete ({ conversations }: SidePaneConversationsChange); cancelable – prevented, `conversations` stays

events.name: tc-model-change
events.description: A model was picked in the toolbar ({ model, choice }: SidePaneModelChange); cancelable – prevented, `model` stays

events.name: tc-settings-change
events.description: The model settings changed ({ settings, changed }: SidePaneSettingsChange); cancelable – prevented, `settings` stays

events.name: tc-page-context-change
events.description: The page-context chip was toggled, or an attached item removed ({ pageContext, change }: SidePanePageContextChange); cancelable – prevented, `pageContext` stays

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The pane was opened or closed ({ open }: SidePaneOpenChange); cancelable – prevented, `open` stays

events.name: tc-collapsed-change
events.description: The pane was collapsed to the rail or expanded ({ collapsed }: SidePaneCollapsedChange); cancelable – prevented, `collapsed` stays

events.name: tc-width-change
events.description: The pane was resized – once a drag ends, and on every arrow-key step ({ width }: SidePaneWidthChange); cancelable – prevented, `width` stays

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The host page – the pane docks beside it

changelog: All 18 blocks are now elements – `tc-agent-gallery`, `tc-ai-side-pane`, `tc-ai-workspace`, `tc-app-directory`, `tc-client-context`, `tc-evidence-gallery`, `tc-header-nav`, `tc-invoice-credit`, `tc-kpi-board`, `tc-logo-marquee`, `tc-metrics-dashboard`, `tc-oversight-home`, `tc-pricing-plans`, `tc-publish-readiness`, `tc-red-team-finding`, `tc-task-board`, `tc-testimonial-wall`, `tc-uncertainty-mix` – so Angular (`trenchcoat/angular`), Vue, Svelte, plain HTML and generative UI get them like any component, with docs pages.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: Form association (ElementInternals)
features.why: The element's value is submitted with its form, and it takes part in form validation and reset.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container query units (cqi, cqw…)
features.why: Sizes relative to the component's own width.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: field-sizing
features.without: Text fields grow with their text. Without it they keep their minimum height and scroll.

features.name: scrollbar-color
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default colours.

features.name: text-wrap: pretty
features.without: Paragraphs may end on a single short word.

features.name: scrollbar-gutter
features.without: Content can shift sideways when a scrollbar appears.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: @property
features.without: The registered custom properties don't interpolate, so the transitions and spins they drive jump to their end state.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
